remarks: TO BE BUILT HOME | OTHER HOME DESIGNS AVAILABLE Welcome to The Cambridge — a beautifully designed two-story home offering 2,730 square feet, 4 bedrooms, and 2.5 bathrooms with plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining. The heart of the home is the impressive two-story great room, featuring soaring ceilings, large windows, and a fireplace that creates a warm and inviting gathering space. The open-concept main floor flows seamlessly into the spacious kitchen, complete with a large center island, abundant cabinetry, and a double-door pantry. A flexible room just off the foyer provides the perfect space for a home office, playroom, or additional living space, while the formal dining room offers an ideal setting for family meals and entertaining. Upstairs, all four bedrooms provide comfortable private spaces, with a walk-in closet in each bedroom. The spacious primary suite features a large bedroom, dual vanities, private water closet, and generous walk-in closet. The Cambridge also offers a variety of options to personalize your home, including a sunroom, covered patio, and more. Several other home designs are also available, giving you the flexibility to choose the floor plan that best fits your lifestyle. Build with Forbes Capretto Homes!
